# Scope notification visual states to their type and contrast mode

The current notification CSS groups donation, blog, message and security variants under explicit host type selectors, sets paired system foreground/background colors in high contrast, and suppresses the donation illustration there. Light/dark illustration choice is separate. Preserve those state selectors and color pairs when adding a variant. Do not use the untested CSS as proof of adequate contrast or a global rule to remove all illustrations.

Scope: Notification visual-state contracts.
